svg.title: SeizeFreeze reference anatomy and enlarged proposed device
svg.desc: Human Reference Atlas brain with an illustrative left superior temporal target. Inset shows the same proposed geometry enlarged. No patient localization or clinical performance is represented.
svg.metadata: Kristen Browne; Heidi Schlehlein / HuBMAP. CC BY 4.0. HRA Brain Male v1.3 and United Male v1.5. Display extraction, materials and concept device added for SeizeFreeze.
